rules: Arrange leading, label and trailing in that order inside container; label uses the required non-empty label prop.
Use content width up to available width; keep label on one line, then truncate with an ellipsis while preserving the full accessible name.
Use the greater of minHeight and content height plus vertical padding; meet minTarget without requiring the visible container to grow.
Emit an activation only when neither disabled nor loading.
Resolve interaction colors in this order: disabled, loading, pressed, hover, default. Focus is independent.
While loading, center loadingIndicator over container; hide leading, label and trailing visually while preserving their layout and the accessible name.
Keep loadingIndicator visible when loading and disabled are both true; use resolved content color.
Draw the container border only for outline; it must not change the outer dimensions.
Use focusColor, focusWidth and focusOffset for a visible focus indicator when focus is true.
Loading animation belongs to the component implementation.
Render leading and trailing foreground content using the resolved content color.
